subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Speaking – the future of technology
outcomes: Give and ask for opinions about technology.
Agree and disagree politely with phrases like 'That's true, but ...'.
Work with a partner to reach an agreement in a collaborative task.

tf.s: 'In my view' is used for giving an opinion.
'What do you think?' asks for someone's opinion.
tf.why: It invites your partner to share their view.

tf.s: 'I'm not sure' is a polite way to disagree.
tf.why: It shows you don't fully agree, in a gentle way.

tf.s: 'That's a good point' is used for disagreeing.
tf.why: 'That's a good point' shows you agree or accept an idea.

tf.s: The speakers agree that the AI clothes assistant is the most useful.
tf.why: They decide on the clothes assistant.

tf.s: 'That's true, but ...' says something positive before disagreeing.
tf.why: It accepts part of the idea before giving another view.

tf.s: In a collaborative task, you should only give your own ideas and ignore your partner.
tf.why: You should respond to your partner and try to reach an agreement.

tf.s: We say 'What's your view at the AI doctor?'
The speakers discuss an AI household assistant, an AI doctor and an AI clothes assistant.
tf.why: These are the three AI robots in the recording.

tf.s: Shouting is a good way to persuade the other group in a debate.
tf.why: Good reasons and polite language persuade people.

boxes.q: Complete: What's your view ___ the AI doctor?
Complete: ___ me, an AI clothes assistant would be useful.

boxes.why: 'That's a good point' accepts an idea.

boxes.q: Complete: I don't ___. I think they're all interesting.
Which phrase asks for an opinion?
boxes.why: It's a question about the other person's idea.
'In my view' starts your own idea.

boxes.q: Which AI robot do the speakers agree is most useful?
boxes.why: They agree on the clothes assistant.

boxes.q: What is the aim of a collaborative task?
o: to try to reach an agreement
to talk alone for five minutes
boxes.why: You discuss ideas together and try to agree.

boxes.q: Which is a polite way to disagree?
boxes.why: It respects the other person's idea first.

mcq.q: Which three AI robots do the speakers discuss?
o: a household assistant, a doctor and a clothes assistant
a teacher, a driver and a cook
a cleaner, a pilot and a nurse
a footballer, a singer and a doctor
mcq.why: These are the three AI robots in the recording.

mcq.q: Which phrase is used for asking for an opinion?
mcq.why: It is a question to your partner.

mcq.q: Which group does 'I'm not sure' belong to?
mcq.why: It's a gentle way to disagree.

o: decide together on the same idea
mcq.why: In a collaborative task you try to agree.

mcq.q: Your partner says, 'A cleaning robot is the most useful.' Which response is best?
o: That's true, it saves time. But for me, a homework assistant would be more useful.
mcq.why: Respond to your partner, then give your idea.

mcq.q: Respond politely: 'Robots will do all our homework.'
o: That's a good point, but I think we still need to learn for ourselves.
Yes, and I'll never study again!
mcq.why: Accept the idea, then give your view politely.

mcq.q: Complete: 'I think robots will be everywhere. ___' (ask your partner)
mcq.why: Ask your partner's opinion to keep the discussion going.

mcq.q: Why is 'That's true, but ...' a polite way to disagree?
o: It accepts part of the other idea before giving a different view
mcq.why: Starting positively keeps the discussion friendly.

mcq.q: Which is a good reason why an AI teacher at home might not be good?
o: Children learn social skills by being with classmates and teachers
AI teachers are always too slow
mcq.why: Learning with others builds social skills.

mcq.q: Why should you respond to your partner before giving your own idea?
o: It shows you listened and helps you reach an agreement
It means you don't need an opinion
